# @trysac/webhook-verifier

> TypeScript library for Node.js 20+ that verifies HMAC webhook signatures on the raw body with GitHub, Standard Webhooks and Stripe-style presets, timestamp tolerance, a replay store and key rotation. Published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example and API summary
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules, boundaries and verification flow
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model, defended and undefended threats
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): the test suite and coverage rules
- [Decisions](docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): architecture decision records
